vqa.question: Describe the land-cover and major objects visible in this image.
vqa.answer: The remote-sensing image reveals a diverse landscape. Prominent vegetation canopy covers the northwest quadrant, adjacent to a defined surface water reservoir in the southwest. The eastern sector features built-up residential and commercial infrastructure interconnected by a regional road network.
